name: ibis Styles Bangkok Sukhumvit Phra Khanong
short_description: A design-economy hotel with easy access to BTS Phra Khanong and a complimentary shuttle, with a 4.3/5 ALL Rating (1,109 reviews).
ai_summary: ibis Styles Bangkok Sukhumvit Phra Khanong is perfectly located on Sukhumvit Road with easy access to BTS Phra Khanong station, including a complimentary shuttle service to the station. The property holds a 4.3/5 ALL Rating from 1,109 reviews, with a contemporary, colourful design blending modern style with local Thai touches. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: 1122 Sukhumvit Road, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, 10110 Bangkok, Thailand
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: Solid 4.3/5 ALL Rating from a substantial 1,109-review base
Complimentary shuttle service to BTS Phra Khanong station
Contemporary, colourful ibis Styles design with local Thai touches
cons: Phra Khanong is further from central Bangkok's main attractions than Sukhumvit's core soi cluster
research_highlights: Complimentary shuttle to BTS Phra Khanong
